label: phoU
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the phoU window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor phoU, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,394 to 4,473 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying phoU once); 42,506 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.40 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,937 calls, named 93%, 0.19 bits; shell 14,240 calls, named 83%, 0.75 bits; cloud 329 calls, named 16%, 3.06 bits. Outside an RGP 29,898 calls, named 91%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 12,608 calls, named 84%, 0.76 bits. Columns: 49 spine, 14 fork, 17 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.76 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (84% against 91%); 12,608 of the 42,506 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 69 (yicJ, a fork column) 1.26 bits, RGP 53%; column 68 (setC, a fork column) 1.10 bits, RGP 51%; column 1 (bglG, a fork column) 1.06 bits, RGP 74%. The 19 columns (columns 1-7, 29-34, 42-44 and 68-70) where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.54 bits on average; the other 61 columns: named 89%, 0.35 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 49 spine columns: named 90%, 0.28 bits on average; the 31 fork and variable columns: named 87%, 0.57 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 69, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 30 (variable), RGP 78%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: phoU. named 99%; 0.04 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-8 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: share 47-73%, all S, RGP 41-74%. named 68-92% (mean 86%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1, named 68%, 1.06 bits.

[S3] 3. columns 9-29 (21 columns) spine: share 90-99%, all P, RGP 0.4-53%.
